title: PAM Engineer
summary: A PAM engineer runs the system that stores and controls powerful admin passwords and sessions (privileged access management, or PAM). They sit in the security or identity team and keep tools like CyberArk, BeyondTrust or Delinea running so that admin access is vaulted, rotated and recorded.
dailyDuties: Deploy and upgrade PAM components such as the vault, session and password managers
Onboard privileged accounts and set rotation and checkout rules
Configure session recording and isolation for admin logins
Integrate the platform with Active Directory and SSO
Automate onboarding and reporting with scripts and APIs
Troubleshoot connector, session and credential issues
Produce privileged access evidence for audits

skills.expectation: Deploy and run a PAM suite such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust or Delinea end to end
Onboard privileged accounts and manage directory and domain admin access
Administer the Windows servers the PAM components run on
Administer the Linux servers the PAM components run on
Automate account onboarding and rotation with scripts and APIs
Automate account onboarding and rotation with scripts and APIs
Integrate the PAM platform with SSO using SAML or OIDC
Troubleshoot session, connector and credential issues methodically
Onboard application owners and document privileged access processes
Place vaults and jump hosts safely in the network
Use platform REST APIs for bulk and automated tasks
Align privileged access with policy and least privilege
Produce privileged access evidence for audits

groups.label: A server operating system (Linux or Windows Server)
A scripting language for identity automation (PowerShell or Python)
